overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated potato flakes in India for global food processors and brands. Cooked, mashed, dried, and sieved, this ingredient rehydrates quickly for seamless kitchen and factory operations. It provides genuine potato flavor and stable texture without fresh potato preparation. The product reduces labor, peeling, and storage concerns across demanding industrial processes.

Operating as an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides dependable supply for wholesale and retail formats. Every batch undergoes controlled processing from raw material inspection through packing. We offer standard bulk consignments, custom mesh sizing, export documentation support, and OEM private labeling. A minimum order quantity of 5 Kg supports testing and scaled production.
highlights: Formulated with standard 80-100 mesh granulation for consistent blending
Low moisture content of 8 percent or less for extended stability
Characteristic cream to light yellow appearance and clean potato profile
Rapid rehydration performance in hot or cold formulations
Twelve-month shelf life when stored in recommended dry conditions
Processed with zero artificial flavorings or unnecessary fillers
applications: Instant mashed potato and potato puree mixes
Potato croquettes, patties, cutlets, and nuggets
Snack pellets, extruded snacks, and savory snack systems
Soups, sauces, gravies, and convenience food formulations
Bakery items, potato breads, rolls, and dough systems
Coating, binding, and bulking systems for prepared foods
Ready-to-cook meals and institutional foodservice products
Seasoned potato mixes and retail instant food products
industries: Seasoning, dry mix, and sauce compounding

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated potato flakes?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, which supports both initial testing and commercial batch production.

faqs.q: Can TradeNest Naturals supply custom mesh sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. While 80-100 mesh is our standard, custom mesh sizes and granulation profiles can be prepared upon request.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for buyers?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, as well as customized private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: What is the recommended storage and shelf life?
faqs.a: The product has a shelf life of 12 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you offer private label and contract manufacturing services?
faqs.a: Yes. TradeNest Naturals provides complete OEM and private-label packaging options alongside bulk industrial supply.

faqs.q: Can international buyers obtain samples and export documentation?
faqs.a: Yes. As an IEC-registered exporter, TradeNest Naturals provides evaluation samples and export documentation support.
